decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game through disruptive spells and Planeswalkers, while ramping up mana to eventually cast a game-winning Scapeshift. Using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the board and generate card advantage, the deck aims to set up the combo of casting Scapeshift to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and multiple Mountains to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes versatile removal spells and a toolbox of lands to support its game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards, disrupt the opponent's gameplay with creatures like Grief and Architects of Will, and then use the combo of Violent Outburst and Living End to bring back all of the cycled creatures from the graveyard for a powerful board presence. The deck utilizes a few counterspells to protect the combo, along with cards like Shardless Agent to help dig for combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures and disrupt their strategy to secure a win.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing powerful Elemental creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It seeks to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage and board presence with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value with its flickering effect. By managing board state and utilizing a mix of removal and counterspells, this deck aims to stall the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its Elemental synergies and powerful threats.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently by using early spell disruption and efficient creature threats. The deck focuses on countering opponent's spells while deploying threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. The deck aims to maintain tempo and card advantage through cards like Expressive Iteration and Archmage's Charm, while also having the flexibility to answer threats with Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruption and aggression.

The deck focuses on aggressively playing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells like Counterspell and Archmage's Charm. Cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide removal for key threats, while Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Dress Down offer additional control options. The mana base includes fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent access to the deck's mana requirements. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent quickly while maintaining control of the game through counterspells and removal.

The main concept of this deck is to use cards like Grief, Violent Outburst, and Living End to disrupt the opponent's hand and board, while cycling through cards with Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder to set up for a big Living End cascade. The deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures and then cascade into Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces.

This deck focuses on applying early pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures and removal spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push. The deck utilizes powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive game plan, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure smooth mana development.

The deck revolves around assembling a strong board presence using creatures that synergize well together, such as Grist, the Hunger Tide, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and various mana dorks. It aims to utilize Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling to tutor up key combo pieces and answer opposing threats efficiently. The toolbox aspect of the deck allows for flexibility in adapting to different matchups. Additionally, the inclusion of Blood Artist provides a win condition by draining opponents for life as creatures enter and leave the battlefield. The deck's strategy is focused on assembling a cohesive creature-based combo while controlling the game through removal and disruption.

The deck focuses on creating a toolbox of creatures to combo off and disrupt opponents. It utilizes cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide, Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for specific creatures and generate value. The deck also includes various mana dorks like Gilded Goose and Ignoble Hierarch to ramp up and accelerate its game plan. With a mix of resilient creatures like Strangleroot Geist and Young Wolf, as well as utility creatures like Endurance and Scavenging Ooze, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver its opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main idea behind the deck is to assemble a powerful equipment combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Colossus Hammer, the deck aims to equip creatures with powerful equipment like Kaldra Compleat and Nettlecyst to deal massive damage in a short amount of time. The deck includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Esper Sentinel to disrupt opponents' plans and control the game tempo, giving the combo enough time to take over and secure a victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus, utilizing key cards like Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands to gain extra mana advantage. The deck aims to assemble the Amulet Titan combo to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and land-based synergies for a quick win. Utilizing lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle for additional value and versatility in the late game. The strategy revolves around efficiently utilizing land drops and mana acceleration to establish a dominant board presence.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on using efficient removal spells and counter magic to control the board while deploying aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck's curve is low, allowing for quick tempo plays and card advantage through cards like Expressive Iteration and Archmage's Charm. Jace, the Mind Sculptor provides additional card advantage and control, while cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat offer versatile removal options. Overall, the deck aims to maintain pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing powerful planeswalkers and creatures, supported by the UrzaTron lands to generate massive amounts of mana. The key strategy involves using Ancient Stirrings, Sylvan Scrying, and Expedition Map to assemble the UrzaTron lands quickly, allowing for early plays of Karn Liberated and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt opponents' game plans. With a mix of removal spells, graveyard hate, and versatile threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, the deck can effectively handle a variety of matchups and dominate the late game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Tameshi Bloom's ability to manipulate reality and create powerful synergies with other cards in the deck. By combining cards like Lotus Bloom, Wargate, and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck can quickly ramp up its mana and search for key pieces to execute a devastating combo. With versatile creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Cultivator Colossus, the deck can pressure opponents on multiple fronts while maintaining control with cards like Prismatic Ending and Wrenn and Six. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its intricate combo plays and versatile threats.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and versatile threats. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for added value and flexibility in longer games. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, alongside efficient creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ice-Fang Coatl. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the diverse color requirements of the spells and ensure consistent access to all necessary resources.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through interaction with opponents' spells and abilities while utilizing powerful artifacts to generate value and advantage. Urza, Lord High Artificer is a key card in this strategy, providing mana acceleration and token generation. The deck also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Esper Sentinel to disrupt opponents' plans and maintain control of the game. Utilizing Urza's Saga alongside various artifacts, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and eventually overwhelm them with a combination of threats and disruption.
